text:
Alex G: Small follow-up: the examples in the structured-output page show `arguments` always as object. We should add an explicit example for array-returning tools (e.g., search_results) and an example of canonical wrapping.

Nadia P: Agreed. For array tools, suggest wrapping like:

```
{ "parse_result": { "status": "ok", "call": { "name": "search_results", "arguments": { "items": [ {"id":1}, {"id":2} ] } } } }
```

Tyler H: Also add a short note about serializing numeric IDs as strings vs numbers (some models emit quotes). Show both and recommend schema with `oneOf` if needed.

Alex G: I'll add both examples. Quick ask: can someone add a tiny lint check in docs CI to ensure every structured-output example includes either `parse_result` or an explicit "JSON starts here" comment?

DocsBot: Issue opened: docs#lib-88 "lint examples for structured output".

Nadia P: I'll take the lint rule. Will add it as a Markdown check in the docs CI.

Tyler H: Also propose we add a small FAQ item: "Model sometimes adds commentary before JSON; what to do?" with lenient-extract and envelope options.

Alex G: Good. I'll draft. Plan: land these as a small patch to structured-output page ahead of the release.

DocsBot: PR Alex G: docs#4215 "structured-output: array tool examples + FAQ" (reviewers: Nadia P, Tyler H).

Nadia P: Reviewing now. Minor wording nits.

Alex G: Fixed nits, thanks. Hoping to merge after one more approval.

Tyler H: LGTM. Merge when green.

DocsBot: docs#4215 merged by Alex G.
